policy.nativeValues: Native input and textarea values use their padded content boxes and vertically centred input line boxes; DOM text uses Range rectangles.
policy.intrinsicControls: Functional controls may end within a column. All are checked for containment and text clearance.
policy.tableEdges: Collapsed table borders paint once; column edges are measured from the first row.
policy.pseudoBorders: Only the existing 9px disclosure chevron is allowed as a functional border icon.
policy.figures: SVG strokes are figure content, not CSS section dividers. Figure bounds are audited; SVG text bounds use npm run qa:figures.
